answer: Work waits on the canyon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wander of the next round. Reaching the copper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
